rdfs:label: Tracker
rdfs:comment: A workflow (wf:) tracker — a set of issues (wf:Task subclasses, or in some apps ical:Vtodo items) plus the constraints on how they move between states; the list-level counterpart to a single task.
notes: From the W3C Workflow vocabulary (`wf:`). A Tracker bundles many issues into a single addressable resource — the right level for list views ("my tasks", "team backlog") whereas a single Vtodo/wf:Task is the right level for editing one task. Issues point at their tracker with `wf:tracker` (domain wf:Task, range wf:Tracker); the tracker declares `wf:issueClass` and `wf:initialState` (a wf:State class such as wf:Open, not a string). `wf:issue` is not tracker→issue: upstream it links a state Transition to the issue it changes. LOSOS's bespoke `todo-pane.js` is registered against Tracker (the list), and individual Vtodos render inside it.

history.note: Initial term — added so a Tracker resource can register a bespoke pane (LOSOS todo-pane) at the right granularity.

Example rewritten to wf: semantics (issues link via wf:tracker, issueClass/initialState as IRIs, ical:summary full IRI, absolute @ids; dropped non-registry initialState and misused wf:issue); comment aligned with upstream.
